zh.name: 字体搭配样张
zh.summary: 同一段标题和正文反复使用不同字体组合，让读者比较真正的层级和气质。
zh.useWhen: 必须有可辨认字体名、相同样本文字和实际搭配；不是字体名称清单。
zh.instructions: 可用字体与授权、统一样文、标题和正文字级
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Font Pairing Showcase
en.summary: Create an Instagram showcase carousel using the font pairing showcase structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the font pairing showcase format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.
